  • Job Type: Freelance
  • Work Schedule: Part-time - 25+ flexible hours per week
  • Start Date: Immediately
  • Duration: TBC
  • Rate: 20.25 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of Legal AI

Are you a legal professional, contract specialist, or law graduate seeking flexible remote work? Are you interested in shaping the development and safety of advanced AI models designed to automate contract management and analysis?

What You’ll Do:

The role involves performing specialized legal data-related tasks across international business contracts, including:

  • Multilingual legal-domain data collection, evaluation, and annotation.
  • Analyzing clauses, obligations, and terms within complex business agreements.
  • Participating in onboarding, calibration sessions, and targeted quality reviews.
  • Collaborating on multi-use-case workflows within secure client environments.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Legal Expertise: Contract or legal domain expertise, with strong legal interpretation and contract-review skills (especially regarding international and cross-jurisdictional contracts).
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in English alongside the relevant target language.
  • AI & Data Capabilities (Preferred): Prior data-annotation experience or familiarity with machine learning data evaluation and quality assurance tasks.

What We Offer:

  • Flexible schedule
  • Opportunity to earn extra income
  • Timely payments

At Appen, we work with 8 out of the top 10 global technology companies in the world to improve and optimize their products for users worldwide, including social media platforms, search engines, voice recognition systems, and eCommerce sites. The world of tech is moving fast, and since our founding in 1996 we rose to the challenge by becoming a publicly listed company and by building an international team that works in over 130 countries and in more than 180 languages.

 

Do you love to surf the internet and want to influence how we interact with technology? As a Search Engine Evaluator with Appen you have the opportunity to provide feedback on news feeds, advertisements and search results. Your ideas have a direct impact on the services and content from social media and search platform sites that we use every single day.

 

You Might Fit This Role If:

• You are looking for a flexible work opportunity where you contribute to projects and grow your skills

• You are an active and engaged user on social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram

• You enjoy working independently

• You want to do internet-based work from home

• Access to a computer with a sound card and speakers, and/ or access to a smart phone that is less than three years old

• Ability to work with applications, troubleshoot software, and execute instructions independently

      <title>Plumeria - Voice Message Collection Project - India</title>
      <description><p>DataForce by TransPerfect is looking for people living in India to share existing WhatsApp voice messages for a short, remote project. If you use voice messages to chat in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, or Urdu, this could be a good fit for you. You don’t need to record anything new!</p><h4>Who is this for?</h4><p>You may qualify if you’re a native speaker of one of these languages and have <strong>12–15 minutes of voice messages you personally recorded and sent in a single WhatsApp conversation before November 12, 2026</strong>.</p><h4>What will you do?</h4><p>You will select one WhatsApp chat containing approximately 12–15 minutes of voice messages in your selected project language(s) that you personally recorded and sent, export it, and submit it through our DataForce Contribute app following the guidelines shared by our team.</p><p>Only existing voice messages sent <strong>before November 12, 2026</strong> are eligible. Newly recorded or scripted messages will not be accepted.</p><p>Only your own voice messages count toward the required audio. Messages containing personal information, unintelligible speech, or explicit content will not be accepted.</p><h4>Who can participate?</h4><p>To qualify, you must:</p><ul><li><p>Be a native speaker of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, or Urdu.</p></li><li><p>Currently live in India.</p></li><li><p>Have approximately 12–15 minutes of your own existing WhatsApp voice messages in one conversation in your selected project language.</p></li><li><p>Sign the participation consent form before submitting your messages.</p></li></ul><p>If you are a native speaker of more than one project language and have suitable voice messages in each, you can indicate this in a single application.</p><h4>Where is the project taking place?</h4><p>This is a fully <strong>remote</strong> project. You can participate from the comfort of your home.</p><h4>Workload</h4><p>The task is estimated to take approximately 30 minutes per language submission, including reviewing the guidelines, exporting the conversation, and uploading your submission.</p><p>All submissions will undergo quality review to confirm the speaker, language, recording dates, audio clarity, and absence of personal information in the accepted audio.</p><h4>Compensation</h4><p>Compensation is<strong> $12 USD for each accepted submission containing at least 10 minutes of approved audio per language.</strong></p><p>You will also receive a <strong>$3 USD completion bonus per accepted submission</strong> if you submit by the deadline specified in your project instructions email.</p><p><br>As payment method, we offer <strong>PayPal, Gift Card, and Wire Transfer</strong>, according to your preference.</p><p>Please note that our Quality Assurance team will review all submissions to ensure they meet the project specific requirements. The project team will provide you with feedback once the Quality Check process is completed.</p><h4>Questions or doubts?</h4><p>If you have any doubts or questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at: <a target="_blank" href="mailto:DataForce.Sourcing@transperfect.com">DataForce.Sourcing@transperfect.com</a></p><p>If you're interested in participating and meet the above qualifying criteria, please click Apply Here, and complete the registration form.</p></description>

<script>
function moveElements() {
  const triggers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-move-element="trigger"]');

  triggers.forEach((trigger) => {
    const parent = trigger.parentElement;

    if (!parent) return;

    const target = parent.querySelector('[data-move-element="target"]');

    if (!target) return;

    target.appendChild(trigger);
  });
}

function trackAllImgsLoad() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-track-all-img-load]").forEach(async (parent) => {
      const images = [...parent.querySelectorAll("img")];

      await Promise.all(
        images.map(
          (img) =>
            new Promise((resolve) => {
              const onLoad = () => {
                img.classList.add("loaded");
                resolve();
              };

              if (img.complete) {
                onLoad();
              } else {
                img.addEventListener("load", onLoad, { once: true });
                img.addEventListener("error", onLoad, { once: true });
              }
            })
        )
      );

      parent.classList.add("loaded");
    });
};

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  moveElements();
  trackAllImgsLoad();
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
  const tabLink = event.target.closest(".b_m_link.w-tab-link");

  if (!tabLink || window.innerWidth < 992) return;

  setTimeout(function () {
    const activeTabPane = document.querySelector(
      ".w-tab-pane.w--tab-active"
    );

    if (!activeTabPane) return;

    const topOffset = 80;
    const paneTop = activeTabPane.getBoundingClientRect().top;

    // Do nothing when the pane's top is already visible
    if (paneTop >= topOffset && paneTop < window.innerHeight) return;

    window.scrollTo({
      top: window.scrollY + paneTop - topOffset,
      behavior: "smooth"
    });
  }, 100);
});
</script>
<script>
const state = {
  jobs: { result: [], count: 0 },
  keyword: "",
  pagination: { page: 1, limit: 18, loading: false },
  els: {
    wrapper: document.querySelector(".jobs_list"),
    formSearch: document.querySelector(".jobs_form_form"),
    inputSearch: document.querySelector(".jobs_form_search"),
    btnSearchSubmit: document.querySelector(".jobs_form_btn"),
    btnFormSubmit: document.querySelector("input[type='submit']"),
    formFilters: document.querySelector(".jobs_popup_form"),
  },
  trackingString: "",
  searchTimeout: null,
  observer: null,
};

async function initApp() {
  initSearch();
  initPopover();
  await updateJobs(true);
}

initApp();

async function updateJobs(checkParams = false) {
  const existingSentinel = document.querySelector(".scroll-sentinel");
  if (existingSentinel) existingSentinel.remove();

  if (state.observer) {
    state.observer.disconnect();
  }

  state.pagination.page = 1;
  state.pagination.loading = false;
  state.jobs.result = [];

  renderLoader();

  if (checkParams) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const search = params.get("search");

    if (search) {
      state.els.inputSearch.value = search;
      state.keyword = search;
    }
  }

  try {
    await fetchJobs();

    if (!state.trackingString) setUTM();

    renderJobs();
    setupInfiniteScroll();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching jobs:", error);
    state.els.wrapper.innerHTML =
      "<p>Unable to load jobs. Please try again.</p>";
  }
}

function renderLoader() {
  state.els.wrapper.innerHTML = `
    <div class="jobs_loader-wrap">
      <div class="css-loader animate-loader">
        <div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderMoreLoader() {
  if (document.querySelector(".jobs_loader-wrap")) return;

  state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "beforeend",
    `<div class="jobs_loader-wrap">
      <div class="css-loader animate-loader">
        <div></div><div></div><div></div><div></div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  );
}

async function fetchJobs() {
  const baseURL = window.location.href.includes("webflow.io")
    ? "https://dev-api.micro1.ai/api/v1"
    : "https://prod-api.micro1.ai/api/v1";

  const response = await fetch(
    `${baseURL}/job/portal?page=${state.pagination.page}&limit=${state.pagination.limit}&keyword=${encodeURIComponent(state.keyword)}`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: "get_all_jobs",
        filters: { type: ["EXPERT"] },
      }),
    }
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Request failed: ${response.status}`);
  }

  const data = await response.json();
  state.jobs.count = Number(data.total) || 0;

  const newJobs = (data.data || []).slice(0, state.pagination.limit);

  if (state.pagination.page === 1) {
    state.jobs.result = newJobs;
  } else {
    state.jobs.result = [...state.jobs.result, ...newJobs];
  }

  console.log("Jobs loaded:", state.jobs.result.length);
}

function renderJobs() {
  state.els.wrapper.innerHTML = "";

  if (state.jobs.count === 0) {
    renderNoResults();
    return;
  }

  renderJobsHeader();
  renderJobsList();
}

function renderJobsHeader() {
  const clearButton = state.keyword
    ? `<span class="jobs_result-clear" clear-search>Clear search</span>`
    : "";

  state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "afterbegin",
    `<p class="jobs_result-info">${state.jobs.count} ${state.jobs.count === 1 ? "role" : "roles"} found ${clearButton}</p>`
  );

  listenerClearFilters();
}

function renderJobsList() {
  state.jobs.result.forEach((job) => {
    state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", createJobEl(job));
  });
}

function renderLoadMoreSentinel() {
  document.querySelector(".scroll-sentinel")?.remove();

  if (state.jobs.result.length < state.jobs.count) {
    state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
      "afterend",
      '<div class="scroll-sentinel"></div>'
    );

    const sentinel = document.querySelector(".scroll-sentinel");

    if (sentinel && state.observer) {
      state.observer.observe(sentinel);
    }
  }
}

function setupInfiniteScroll() {
  if (state.observer) state.observer.disconnect();

  state.observer = createIntersectionObserver();
  renderLoadMoreSentinel();
}

function createIntersectionObserver() {
  return new IntersectionObserver(
    async (entries) => {
      const entry = entries[0];

      if (
        entry.isIntersecting &&
        !state.pagination.loading &&
        state.jobs.result.length < state.jobs.count
      ) {
        state.observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        await loadMoreJobs();
      }
    },
    { rootMargin: "100px" }
  );
}

async function loadMoreJobs() {
  if (
    state.pagination.loading ||
    state.jobs.result.length >= state.jobs.count
  ) {
    return;
  }

  state.pagination.loading = true;
  renderMoreLoader();

  try {
    const previousLength = state.jobs.result.length;
    state.pagination.page += 1;

    await fetchJobs();

    document.querySelector(".jobs_loader-wrap")?.remove();

    const newJobs = state.jobs.result.slice(previousLength);

    newJobs.forEach((job) => {
      state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", createJobEl(job));
    });

    renderLoadMoreSentinel();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error loading more jobs:", error);
    document.querySelector(".jobs_loader-wrap")?.remove();
  } finally {
    state.pagination.loading = false;
  }
}

function renderNoResults() {
  state.els.wrapper.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "afterbegin",
    `<div class="jobs_result-0-wrap">
      <div class="jobs_result-0-img"></div>
      <p>
        No roles match your search.
        <span class="job_result-0-clear" clear-search>Clear search</span>
      </p>
    </div>`
  );

  listenerClearFilters();
}

function createJobEl(job) {
  const tag = job.job_tags?.[0];

  const date = job.date_posted
    ? new Date(job.date_posted).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
        year: "numeric",
        month: "short",
        day: "numeric",
      })
    : "";

  const allSkills = job.skills || [];
  const skills = allSkills.slice(0, 3);
  const link = job.apply_url ? formatLink(job.apply_url) : "";

  return `
    <a href="${link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
       class="jobs_item w-inline-block">
      <div class="jobs_hover"></div>

      <div class="jobs_top-wrap">
        <div class="jobs_info-wrap">
          <div class="jobs_date">${date}</div>
        </div>

        <h2 class="jobs_name">${job.job_name || ""}</h2>

        <div class="jobs_skills">
          ${skills.length ? "<div>Required skills</div>" : ""}
          <div class="jobs_skills-list">
            ${skills.map((skill) =>
              `<div class="jobs_skill-cap"><div>${skill}</div></div>`
            ).join("")}
            ${
              allSkills.length > 3
                ? `<div class="jobs_skill-cap"><div>${allSkills.length - 3}+</div></div>`
                : ""
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="jobs_bottom">
        <div class="jobs_salary">
          ${
            job.ideal_hourly_rate || job.ideal_yearly_compensation
              ? salary(tag, job.ideal_hourly_rate, job.ideal_yearly_compensation)
              : ""
          }
        </div>

        <div class="jobs_cta">
          <div class="jobs_cta-icon w-embed">
            <svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                 fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M3.75 12L20.25 12"
                    stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"
                    stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
              <path d="M13.5 5.25L20.25 12L13.5 18.75"
                    stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"
                    stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
            </svg>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </a>
  `;
}

function formatCompensation(amount) {
  if (amount == null || amount === 0) return "0";

  if (amount >= 1000000) {
    const value = Math.floor((amount / 1000000) * 10) / 10;
    return `${value % 1 === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)}M`;
  }

  if (amount >= 1000) {
    const value = Math.floor((amount / 1000) * 10) / 10;
    return `${value % 1 === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)}K`;
  }

  return amount.toString();
}

function salary(tag, hourly, comp) {
  if (tag === "Core team") {
    if (!comp) return "";

    const min = formatCompensation(comp.min);
    const max = formatCompensation(comp.max);

    return `
      <div dataset-popover="wrapper" class="jobs_salary">
        <div>Compensation: <span class="job_salary-bold">$${min}-${max}/yr</span></div>
        <div dataset-popover="target" class="jobs_salary-trigger"></div>
        <div dataset-popover="item" class="popover_item is-salary">
          <div>Total compensation includes base salary, bonuses, and benefits.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  if (hourly) {
    return `
      <div class="jobs_salary">
        <div>Pay: <span class="job_salary-bold">$${hourly.min}-${hourly.max}/h</span></div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  return "";
}

function jobTag(tag) {
  const config = {
    "Core team": {
      className: "is-core",
      text: "This opening is for the micro1 core team as a full time employee",
    },
    "Extended team": {
      className: "is-extended",
      text: "As a contractor working with the micro1 core team closely",
    },
  };

  const item = config[tag];
  if (!item) return "";

  return `
    <div dataset-popover="wrapper" class="jobs_tag_wrap">
      <div dataset-popover="target" class="jobs_tag ${item.className}">
        ${tag}
      </div>
      <div dataset-popover="item" class="popover_item">${item.text}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function initPopover() {
  const jobList = state.els.wrapper;
  if (!jobList) return;

  const isMobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 991px)").matches;

  if (isMobile) {
    jobList.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      const target = event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']");
      if (!target) return;

      event.preventDefault();

      const wrapper = target.closest("[dataset-popover='wrapper']");
      wrapper?.classList.toggle("show-popover");
    });

    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      if (event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']")) return;

      document.querySelectorAll(".show-popover").forEach((element) => {
        element.classList.remove("show-popover");
      });
    });
  } else {
    jobList.addEventListener("mouseover", (event) => {
      const target = event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']");
      if (!target) return;

      target.closest("[dataset-popover='wrapper']")
        ?.classList.add("show-popover");
    });

    jobList.addEventListener("mouseout", (event) => {
      const target = event.target.closest("[dataset-popover='target']");
      if (!target) return;

      target.closest("[dataset-popover='wrapper']")
        ?.classList.remove("show-popover");
    });
  }
}

function initSearch() {
  if (state.els.formSearch) {
    state.els.formSearch.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      runSearch();
    });
  }

  if (state.els.inputSearch) {
    state.els.inputSearch.addEventListener("input", () => {
      clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);

      state.searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        runSearch();
      }, 300);
    });

    state.els.inputSearch.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter") {
        event.preventDefault();
        clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);
        runSearch();
      }
    });
  }

  if (state.els.btnSearchSubmit) {
    state.els.btnSearchSubmit.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);
      runSearch();
    });
  }
}

function runSearch() {
  const keyword = state.els.inputSearch.value.trim();

  if (keyword === state.keyword) return;

  state.keyword = keyword;
  updateJobs();
}

function clearSearch() {
  clearTimeout(state.searchTimeout);

  state.els.inputSearch.value = "";
  state.keyword = "";

  updateJobs();
}

function listenerClearFilters() {
  document.querySelectorAll(
    ".jobs_result-clear, .job_result-0-clear, [clear-search]"
  ).forEach((element) => {
    // Avoid attaching duplicate listeners when the list is rerendered.
    if (element.dataset.clearSearchBound === "true") return;

    element.dataset.clearSearchBound = "true";

    element.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      clearSearch();
    });
  });
}

function setUTM() {
  let { cusRef, portalParams } = customTrackData;
  let finalString = portalParams || "";

  if (!finalString.includes("utm_source") && cusRef) {
    if (cusRef.includes("google")) cusRef = "google";

    finalString += `${finalString ? "&" : ""}utm_source=${encodeURIComponent(cusRef)}`;
  }

  state.trackingString = finalString;
}

function formatLink(href, queryString = state.trackingString) {
  if (!href) return "";

  const base = href.split("?")[0];
  return queryString ? `${base}?${queryString}` : base;
}

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

You'll work directly with the world's leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions, managing expert teams across domains like finance, software engineering, and law to produce high-quality outputs at scale. You'll shape dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved, owning critical projects end-to-end from scoping through delivery in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Along the way, you'll gain top-tier operational experience, working across multiple parts of the business — building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing wherever it's needed most.

Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

  • Manage expert teams across domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like finance, software engineering, law, and more to create high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your taste and judgement will shape what foundation models become.

  • Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping, executing, iterating, and shipping in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

  • Gain top tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ YOE in a top-tier client-facing role (e.g., investment banking, consulting, private equity), as an ex-founder, or in the human-data industry

  • High agency, drive, and a strong work ethic; thrive in ambiguity and execute with minimal direction

  • Passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship; enjoy experimenting with new tools (experience with Claude Code is a plus)

  • Competitive nature and demonstrated past success

  • Strong leadership experience and excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-impact environments with bias towards action, while balancing attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical skills (coding, scripting, or working with data) or experience using AI tools to automate workflows, conduct research, or build products

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

AfterQuery is hiring Growth Associates to architect and scale the expert supply engine powering frontier AI training. You will own both manual and automated acquisition pipelines to grow our expert network from 100K to hundreds of thousands and beyond. This role blends GTM automation engineering, talent acquisition, marketing, conference planning, partnership building, purchasing, and distribution.

This is not a typical “growth” role. It is an operational, and strategic position working directly with our founding team. You will design scalable systems, run experiments, recruit elite experts and operators, build automation stacks, represent AfterQuery at conferences and panels, and drive brand amplification / marketing initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and scale automated expert sourcing pipelines

  • Leverage LinkedIn and similar platforms to identify and bring on professionals from diverse industries

  • Lead purchasing efforts in the up and coming data acquisition field

  • Expand AfterQuery's Conference footprint

  • Expand Campus Partnership efforts with elite universities and MBA/PHD programs

  • Collaborate with Marketing to improve brand awareness and social media strategy

  • Work hand in hand with Engineering on Product Design Optimization

Required Qualifications

  • Experience scaling talent networks or marketplaces, recruiting, or outbound sales/lead generation

  • Scrappiness, thriving in ambiguity, and being able to overcome bottlenecks on the fly

  • Demonstrated track record of elite operational execution

  • Analytical rigor; comfort with funnel modeling and pipeline analytics

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication

  • Evidence of high agency, resourcefulness, and competitive drive

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with GTM tooling (Clay, Instantly, Apollo, Zapier, scripts, scrapers)

  • Willingness to operate in a 5-6 day startup cadence

  • Passion for frontier AI and ambition to build category-defining systems

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

AfterQuery is seeking exceptional undergraduate and masters students for our AI/ML Research Internship program. This is not a typical internship – you'll work directly with our research team on cutting-edge AI projects focused on advanced reasoning, computer use, and agentic models. You'll have access to our network of experts and specialized datasets to support your research contributions. Successful interns will have the opportunity to co-author research papers, gain invaluable experience with frontier AI systems, and potentially present work at leading AI conferences. Students enrolled in undergraduate or masters programs in relevant fields are welcome to apply. This job will demand between 10 and 40 hours per week depending on company needs.

Company Overview

AfterQuery is a research lab investigating the boundaries and capabilities of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. Our customers are the foundation model labs, and we serve all of the frontier AI labs.

We are based in San Francisco, CA, and have raised funding from top investors, including Y Combinator and BoxGroup, ex-partners from Lightspeed and Index Ventures, and senior leadership at Google DeepMind and Meta GenAI.

Our founding team brings backgrounds from Jane Street, Meta, Citadel Securities, Google, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Silver Lake, Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research (BAIR), and Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (SAIL).

Why Apply

  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI research

  • Co-author papers for top AI conferences

  • Access specialized datasets and computational resources

  • Develop highly sought-after industry and academic skills

  • Join one of the fastest growing YC startups

  • Work with AfterQuery’s founding team (Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, Morgan Stanley)

Responsibilities

  • Support research scientists in designing and running experiments

  • Collect, process, and analyze proprietary datasets

  • Help develop and test new algorithms for advanced reasoning and agents

  • Contribute to research documentation and findings

  • Participate in research discussions and present findings

  • Collaborate on interdisciplinary projects with interns and researchers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI, ML, or related research projects

  • Familiarity with large language models and reinforcement learning

  • Knowledge of NLP or multi-modal systems

  • Previous research experience or publications

  • Strong communication skills; able to explain complex concepts

  • Experience with data visualization and analysis tools

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

Working with our core engineering team, you’ll be critical in creating data infrastructure that will be shaping the future development of frontier models. You will get a lot of responsibility, owning entire projects end-to-end – meaning you can see your impact instantly.

Responsibilities

  • Build and scale complex data capturing workflows across web (Next.js) and desktop (Python)

  • Architect and optimize data pipelines that experience high throughput, with heavy loads

  • Collaborate with the founding team to define product strategy and ship features fast.

  • Set engineering best practices and lay the groundwork for future team growth.

Required Qualifications

  • Able to take a gap semester off and join our team in person in San Francisco

  • Proficiency in JavaScript (Next.js) and Python, with demonstrated experience building full-stack web applications

  • Experience with serverless architecture and cloud functions for implementing heavy data processing (GCP/AWS)

  • Storage, caching & search: Hands‑on with Redis (caching), Elasticsearch (indexing), and message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ) to build scalable, low‑latency pipelines.

  • Any background in AI research, LLM evaluation, or human‑in‑the‑loop systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience getting your ideas into production (founder experience preferred)

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

As a Software Engineer - Platform Infrastructure at AfterQuery, you will design and build the core infrastructure that powers our data generation, evaluation, and agentic systems. You will be responsible for the shared platforms that enable our engineers and research teams to run large-scale human-in-the-loop workflows, evaluation harnesses, and automated data pipelines used to train frontier AI models. This is a highly technical role with broad ownership. You will architect and build foundational infrastructure that many other engineers depend on, ensuring systems are scalable, reliable, and capable of supporting extremely high-throughput workloads. You will work directly with the founding team to define system architecture, establish engineering best practices, and build the infrastructure that supports the next generation of AI development.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop the shared infrastructure powering our data generation platforms, human-in-the-loop systems, and evaluation pipelines.

  • Build systems capable of processing large-scale datasets and high-throughput workloads with strong reliability guarantees.

  • Create reusable infrastructure and APIs that enable product engineers and researchers to build quickly and reliably on top of core systems.

  • Design systems with strong observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance to support production workloads at scale.

  • Help define long-term system architecture across data pipelines, compute infrastructure, task orchestration, and storage systems.

  • Work closely with engineers and researchers to support new AI experimentation workflows and platform capabilities.

  • Define standards for system design, deployment, reliability, and infrastructure operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience building production distributed systems or platform infrastructure

  • Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript (Node.js / Next.js) or similar backend technologies

  • Experience designing and operating systems in cloud environments (GCP or AWS)

  • Experience with message queues and event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, etc.)

  • Experience working with high-throughput data pipelines and asynchronous processing systems

  • Strong understanding of system scalability, performance, and reliability

  • Experience owning systems running in production environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or shared infrastructure

  • Experience supporting large-scale data processing pipelines

  • Experience with AI infrastructure, LLM evaluation systems, or ML pipelines

  • Experience working at high-growth startups or scaling early infrastructure

  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop or workflow orchestration systems

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

You'll work directly with the world's leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions, managing expert teams across domains like finance, software engineering, and law to produce high-quality outputs at scale. You'll shape dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved, owning critical projects end-to-end from scoping through delivery in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Along the way, you'll gain top-tier operational experience, working across multiple parts of the business — building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing wherever it's needed most.

Responsibilities

Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

Manage expert teams across domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like software engineering, data science, and machine learning.

Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your taste and judgement will shape what foundation models become.

Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping, executing, iterating, and shipping in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

Gain top tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

2+ YOE in a top-tier tech company (FAANG, frontier AI lab) or quantitative trading firm

Background in software engineering, ML engineering, AI research, or computer science

High agency, drive, and a strong work ethic; thrive in ambiguity and execute with minimal direction

Passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship; enjoy experimenting with new tools (experience with Claude Code is a plus)

Competitive nature and demonstrated past success

Strong leadership experience and excellent written and verbal communication skills

Thrive in fast-moving, high-impact environments with bias towards action, while balancing attention to detail

Proficiency in Python and comfort writing production-quality code

Preferred Qualifications

Technical skills (coding, scripting, or working with data) or experience using AI tools to automate workflows, conduct research, or build products

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

You'll work with the world's leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions, managing expert teams across finance, software engineering, law, and more to deliver high-quality outputs at scale. You'll shape the dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are trained and evaluated, owning projects end-to-end from scoping through delivery in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Along the way, you'll pick up broad operational experience, moving fluidly across building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing wherever the business needs it most.

Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

  • Manage expert teams across domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like software engineering, data science, and machine learning.

  • Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your taste and judgement will shape what foundation models become.

  • Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping, executing, iterating, and shipping in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

  • Gain top tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical background: CS degree, engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability to ship technical projects

  • High agency, drive, and a strong work ethic; thrive in ambiguity and execute with minimal direction

  • Passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship; enjoy experimenting with new tools (experience with Claude Code is a plus)

  • Competitive nature and demonstrated past success

  • Strong leadership experience and excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-impact environments with bias towards action, while balancing attention to detail

  • Proficiency in Python and comfort writing production-quality code

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical skills (coding, scripting, or working with data) or experience using AI tools to automate workflows, conduct research, or build products

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

We're looking for a Marketing Lead to help expand our online presence and brand perception as an industry-leading research lab curating human data. You'll own AfterQuery's expert marketplace strategy, acquisition, activation, matching, retention, and quality — leading the team responsible for expert sourcing, onboarding, and staffing.

You'll build scalable supply systems across domains, partnering with Engineering on requirements for applications, assessments, matching, and automation, and setting the metrics and cadences that track staffing speed, conversion, and quality. You'll work across Ops, Research, and Engineering to match experts to the right projects, grow conversion and marketplace liquidity, and shape the long-term structure of the expert marketplace function.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute AfterQuery’s go-to-market and brand strategy for technical and enterprise audiences

  • Design, launch, and optimize multi-channel marketing campaigns to drive awareness, product adoption, and customer engagement across frontier AI labs

  • Collaborate with founders and technical teams to craft compelling messaging for our offerings and breakthroughs

  • Own marketing content creation—including case studies, whitepapers, presentations, and press releases

  • Analyze campaign effectiveness, optimize strategies, and report on key performance metrics

  • Represent AfterQuery at industry events, conferences, and online communities

Required Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of experience in marketing, product marketing, or growth at a B2B or technical company (AI, software, or data infrastructure experience a strong plus)

  • Deep understanding of AI, ML, and the evolving landscape of foundation models

  • Strong communicator with experience crafting positioning and messaging for technical audiences

  • Proven track record launching and scaling marketing campaigns that drive measurable results

  • Experience working in fast-paced startup or research lab environments

  • Hands-on approach, comfort wearing multiple hats, and ability to execute independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience marketing products or services to AI labs or technical researchers

  • Familiarity with developer-focused or open-source marketing

  • Background in technical writing or communications

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

AfterQuery is hiring a Business Operations Generalist to work directly with the CEO and the internal Operations team as we scale. You will be a key part of the operational backbone of the company — tackling special projects across the business as they arise and building capabilities that don't yet have a home.

You are a utility player: sharp, resourceful, and equally comfortable doing qualitative research, quantitative modeling, and hands-on execution. No task is out of scope. Your job is not to flag problems — it's to diagnose them, build the analysis, and deliver a recommendation that moves the business. Other times, it's to tackle issues before they become problems.

You won't inherit a playbook. You will build one from the ground up, then hand it off and move to the next thing. This is an in-person role in San Francisco, moving at the speed of the company.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of founder- and leadership- assigned special projects from kickoff through delivery, driving decision-making, owning cross-functional initiatives, building operating cadences, and monitoring core business metrics.

  • Build new operational capabilities from scratch: business development support, billing and revenue operations infrastructure, and other functions we stand up as we scale.

  • Gather qualitative and quantitative data, synthesize what you find, and develop actionable recommendations.

  • Assist with business development activities including research, outreach support, deal tracking, and preparing materials for founder-led conversations.

  • Support recruiting end-to-end (sourcing, top-of-funnel outreach, interview coordination, work trials, candidate relationships, and external recruiter management) so hiring moves quickly and without gaps.

  • Identify operational inefficiencies, model the tradeoffs, and propose prioritized solutions with clear implementation plans.

  • Serve as connective tissue across the organization by communicating clearly, following through, and closing the loop.

  • Build for durability, not just delivery. Stand something up, pressure-test it, document it, and hand it off cleanly so that it keeps working after you've moved on to the next problem.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience at a top investment bank, consulting firm, private equity firm, or in a highly analytical strategy or operations role. This is a guideline - we care more about what you’ve done and the impact you’ve had, rather than specific years of experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to build from the ground up. You've operated in environments where the process didn't exist, and you created it.

  • A genuine utility player: equally comfortable building a financial model, drafting a customer email, and mapping an operational workflow — and you don't think any of it is beneath you.

  • High agency, low ego. You don't wait to be told what to do — you identify the gap, propose the solution, and execute. If something is broken, you fix it without being asked.

  • Strong analytical instincts: you default to quantitative analysis and pair it with qualitative judgment. You turn ambiguous problems into specific, data-backed recommendations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You are concise, precise, and can distill complex information into clear decisions. Your work product speaks for itself.

  • Obsessive attention to detail paired with business judgment. You catch what others miss and know what actually matters.

  • Comfortable in a 5-day in-office SF environment that prizes speed, direct feedback, and rapid context-switching.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at an early-stage startup, especially in an operator or Chief of Staff-adjacent capacity.

  • Technical fluency: ability to engage credibly with engineering and research teams.

  • Exposure to AI, data, or tech-adjacent industries, either from prior work or genuine intellectual interest in the space.

  • Experience standing up customer-facing programs, billing systems, or revenue operations from zero.

  • Experience across multiple functions: operations, strategy, finance, go-to-market, product, or recruiting.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

As the Senior SWE- Security Infrastructure, you’ll be responsible for protecting a system that handles highly sensitive workflows across AI training, expert networks, and enterprise integrations with leading model labs.

This role is deeply technical. You’ll design and implement the infrastructure that keeps our systems resilient, rather than managing off-the-shelf security tools. We move fast and rely heavily on AI internally. You should be comfortable using LLMs to accelerate debugging, threat analysis, and system design and just as comfortable replacing repetitive work with code. Security here isn’t isolated. When you’re not working on security problems, you’ll be building core systems especially human-in-the-loop platforms and data infrastructure that power how frontier AI models are developed. We work in-person in San Francisco.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build systems that identify and respond to real security events across our stack

  • Replace manual security workflows with programmatic, scalable solutions

  • Strengthen our cloud and production environments (GCP/AWS, containers, networking)

  • Design and enforce access control systems across internal teams, experts, and customers

  • Integrate security checks directly into development workflows without slowing shipping speed

  • Own incident handling systems and processes from detection through resolution

  • Secure surfaces unique to AI systems, including data flows and model interaction layers

  • Develop human-in-the-loop systems used in AI training and evaluation

  • Contribute to core infrastructure and internal tooling used across the company

  • Ship features across the stack that directly impact customers and model performance

 

Required Qualifications

  • You’ve built internal tools or systems to solve security problems—not just configured existing products

  • Strong programming ability in Python, Go, or TypeScript

  • Experience working with cloud environments (IAM, networking, containers)

  • Ability to identify vulnerabilities directly in code and system design

  • Experience creating or maintaining signal-based monitoring and alerting systems

  • Comfortable owning production issues when they arise

  • Able to move fluidly between security work and general engineering

  • 2-7 years building software or security systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in fast-scaling startups or high-output engineering teams

  • Exposure to AI systems, data pipelines, or model evaluation workflows

  • Familiarity with offensive security techniques

  • Experience building tools that other engineers depend on

  • Evidence of building and shipping systems from zero to production

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

As a SWE (Environments), you will design the simulations, data, and evaluations that directly influence how frontier models learn. You'll work hands-on with research teams at top AI labs, experimenting with environment design, piloting novel data creation strategies, diagnosing model failure modes, and developing the metrics that determine whether a model is actually improving. You'll go from hypothesis to live experiment quickly, and your output will feed directly into model training runs at scale. Day to day, you will design environments, tasks, and data that expose meaningful failure modes across domains like finance, code, and enterprise workflows. You will build and refine reward signals for various RL pipelines. You will develop quantitative frameworks for measuring dataset quality, diversity, and downstream impact on alignment and capability. You will partner with lab research teams to translate their training objectives into concrete data and evaluation specifications.

Responsibilities

  • Construct simulated worlds and explore data shapes that expose meaningful model failure modes across domains like finance, code, and enterprise workflows

  • Build and refine evaluation rubrics and reward signals for RLHF and RLVR training pipelines

  • Analyze agent-produced trajectories and run experiments to improve different model capabilities

  • Develop quantitative frameworks for measuring dataset quality, diversity, and downstream impact on model alignment and capability

  • Create and manage both real world & synthetic data pipelines
    Partner with lab research teams to translate their training objectives into concrete data and evaluation specifications

  • Partner with in-house researchers to run post-training experiments and scale training infrastructure

Required Qualifications

  • Ability to design lightweight experiments, move fast, and extract actionable insights from messy results

  • Experience with using Docker, or similar containerization tools, to design and monitor systems at scale

  • Strong familiarity with common reinforcement learning algorithms and methods, especially with respect to post-training LLMs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Major plus if they've worked for/interned for any RL environment companies in the past or any AI safety or benchmarking orgs like METR, Artificial Analysis, etc.

  • Former founders and early engineers at early stage startups are a plus. We want people who can demonstrate they work hard, learn fast, and care deeply about getting the details right.

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

Your job is to prove that our data works. You will design and run training experiments that isolate the impact of our datasets on model behavior. This includes SFT and RL-based post-training, where you’ll measure how different data sources shift capability, generalization, and alignment. Working closely with partner labs, you will turn our datasets into clear, defensible evidence: this data → this improvement → under these conditions. This is experimental, high-leverage work.

Responsibilities

  • Run controlled SFT and RL experiments to measure the impact of our datasets on model performance.

  • Help build public evals and new data types that push the frontier.

  • Publish external-facing research, blog posts, and technical reports.

  • Work with internal SPLs to iterate on data quality based on your results.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong familiarity with LLM training and evaluation methodologies.

  • Ability to design lightweight experiments, move fast, and extract actionable insights from messy results.

  • Comfort working across domains (you'll touch finance, software engineering, policy, and more).

  • A bias toward building over theorizing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Great candidates are undergrad research or master's research (but haven't done a phd).

  • Genuine obsession with how data structure, selection, and quality drive model behavior.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

AfterQuery builds the data and evaluation systems that power frontier AI models. Every leading AI lab uses our datasets and reinforcement learning environments to encode and scale real-world expertise.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Privacy & Anonymization to build the lasting systems that enable us to handle sensitive customer data safely. You'll own anonymization layers, and infrastructure that sits inline with production software, detects identifying information in whatever passes through it, and transforms that data without destroying its usefulness. You’ll support AfterQuery’s mission by curating trainable data from real-world corpuses.

Responsibilities

  • Build detection models for PII, PHI, and quasi-identifiers across free text, logs, structured payloads, and code

  • Own the transformation layer: redaction, masking, pseudonymization, tokenization, and format-preserving encryption, chosen per entity and policy

  • Ship the runtime adaptor: streaming inference, latency budgets, fail-open vs. fail-closed semantics, schema drift

  • Build evaluation infrastructure with recall-weighted metrics and re-identification attacks against our own output

  • Make anonymization policy a config surface as customer and jurisdiction requirements diverge

  • Own high-impact systems from early design through production deployment

Required Qualifications

  • 3-6 YOE with relevant experiences

  • Strong software engineering background with experience shipping production systems

  • Experience building data pipelines at production scale, handling large volumes of data

  • Applied NLP: NER, sequence labeling, or information extraction on messy text. Fraud or trust/safety detection work where recall on rare events was the objective also counts

  • Experience with low-latency inference services: streaming pipelines, sidecars, or event systems

  • Ability to move quickly in a high-ownership, fast-changing environment

  • Deep care for quality, precision, and customer impact

Preferred Qualifications

  • HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination, GDPR pseudonymization, differential privacy, k-anonymity, synthetic data, tokenization vaults, or prior health-tech/fintech privacy work.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

As one of our first talent coordinator hires, you’ll help build the coordination engine behind AfterQuery’s hiring process. You’ll work closely with the founders, recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to make sure every interview process runs quickly, smoothly, and professionally. This is a high-ownership role for someone extremely organized, detail-oriented, and excited to help scale a world-class talent function from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Own interview scheduling and coordination across the talent team.

  • Coordinate candidate logistics across recruiter screens, technical interviews, onsite interviews, final rounds, and offer processes.

  • Manage communication with candidates throughout the interview process.

  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to ensure interviews are scheduled quickly and accurately.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records in the ATS and recruiting systems.

  • Track candidate progress, feedback status, interviewer availability, and process bottlenecks.

  • Ensure every candidate has a high-touch, professional, and responsive experience.

  • Help improve recruiting workflows, templates, systems, and internal coordination processes.

  • Support the talent team with ad hoc projects as AfterQuery scales.

  • Help prepare interviewers with the right context, scorecards, resumes, and scheduling details.

  • Support recruiting operations, including:

    • Calendar management

    • Interview loop setup

    • Candidate follow-ups

    • Offer process coordination

    • Recruiting reports

    • Process documentation

Required Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, people operations, executive assistance, operations, or another highly organized coordination-heavy role.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to manage many moving pieces at once without dropping details.

  • Comfort working with calendars, scheduling, spreadsheets, ATS systems, and recruiting tools.

  • High responsiveness and strong follow-through.

  • Strong judgment when communicating with candidates, interviewers, and internal teams.

  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Excitement to help build processes from scratch.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating technical recruiting processes.

  • Experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, tech company, or recruiting agency.

  • Familiarity with technical interview loops and hiring workflows.

  • Experience using tools like Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, LinkedIn Recruiter, Google Calendar, Notion, Linear, or similar systems.

  • Strong candidate experience instincts.

  • Comfort working directly with founders, executives, recruiters, and hiring managers.

  • Experience improving scheduling systems, recruiting templates, or internal process documentation.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.
