About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise GTM to own and build AfterQuery's enterprise go-to-market function from the ground up. This person will be responsible for driving enterprise customer acquisition, developing strategic commercial partnerships, structuring complex deals, and ensuring successful delivery of the engagements we sell.

This is a senior, highly autonomous leadership role for someone who can operate as both a strategic leader and a hands-on individual contributor. You will personally identify and pursue high-value enterprise opportunities, build relationships with senior decision-makers, lead complex sales cycles, and translate customer needs into commercially sound engagements that our research and technical teams can execute.

Our core research and technical capabilities are already in place. The primary challenge is bringing those capabilities to the right customers, creating compelling commercial opportunities, and converting them into successful, long-term partnerships. You'll work closely with our researchers and technical leadership to understand what we can deliver, while taking full ownership of how we position, sell, structure, and bring those solutions to market.

You'll own the entire customer lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development through commercial negotiation, engagement launch, delivery, and account expansion. This includes building the operating processes and commercial infrastructure needed to scale the function, as well as establishing and leading a high-performing GTM team as the business grows.

We're looking for someone who can independently drive results from day one, create structure where little exists, and build a repeatable enterprise GTM engine without relying on an existing sales organization or extensive support.

What You'll Do

Own and Build the Enterprise GTM Function

  • Take full ownership of AfterQuery's enterprise go-to-market strategy, commercial execution, and overall customer acquisition efforts.

  • Define and execute the strategy for identifying, pursuing, and closing high-value enterprise opportunities across AI, technology, and other relevant industries.

  • Personally drive outbound prospecting, relationship development, pipeline generation, and strategic account acquisition while building the foundation for a scalable sales organization.

  • Establish our enterprise sales motion, including target account strategy, qualification, positioning, pricing, deal structures, and commercial negotiations.

  • Identify the highest-value customer use cases for custom evaluations, data generation, model training, and post-training engagements.

  • Build the processes, playbooks, metrics, and operating cadence needed to create a repeatable and scalable GTM function.

  • Establish, hire, and lead a high-performing enterprise GTM team as the business scales, setting clear expectations for performance, accountability, and execution.

Drive Enterprise Sales and Commercial Strategy

  • Build and own relationships with senior executives, business leaders, and technical decision-makers across large enterprise organizations.

  • Lead consultative discovery to understand customer workflows, business objectives, technical requirements, and opportunities for AI-driven improvement.

  • Translate customer problems into compelling commercial opportunities, developing proposals that connect AfterQuery's capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial outreach and discovery through solution scoping, pricing, contracting, and deal closure.

  • Structure sophisticated enterprise agreements, balancing customer needs, commercial economics, delivery requirements, and long-term business value.

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing models, engagement structures, contract terms, and expansion opportunities.

  • Develop strategic account relationships that generate repeat business, long-term partnerships, and broader enterprise adoption.

Translate Customer Needs into Executable Engagements

  • Partner closely with AfterQuery's research and technical leadership to understand our capabilities and translate them into differentiated enterprise solutions.

  • Identify and scope technical engagements involving model evaluations, failure analysis, training data, and post-training approaches such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

  • Work with research and technical teams to determine feasibility, resource requirements, timelines, and delivery expectations before committing to customer engagements.

  • Translate customer requirements into clearly defined scopes of work, deliverables, success metrics, and commercially viable engagement structures.

  • Ensure alignment between what is sold commercially and what can be successfully executed by our research and delivery teams.

  • Bring customer feedback, market intelligence, and emerging enterprise needs back to research leadership to inform future capabilities and opportunities.

Own Customer Delivery and Account Expansion

  • Maintain ownership of customer engagements beyond the initial contract, ensuring successful execution and delivery against commercial commitments.

  • Lead the transition from signed agreement to active engagement, coordinating researchers, technical teams, and operational resources.

  • Establish clear accountability for project scope, milestones, deliverables, success criteria, and customer communication.

  • Proactively manage delivery risks, resolve escalations, and ensure customer expectations remain aligned with execution.

  • Monitor engagement performance and commercial outcomes, identifying opportunities to improve delivery models, engagement economics, and customer satisfaction.

  • Turn successful engagements into long-term strategic partnerships, repeat business, case studies, and opportunities for account expansion.

What We're Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic business development, commercial leadership, or enterprise GTM at a high-growth technology company.

  • A proven track record of independently building enterprise pipelines, acquiring major customers, and closing complex, high-value commercial agreements.

  • Experience leading enterprise GTM or sales functions, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the commercial motion from the ground up.

  • Strong commercial judgment and experience structuring sophisticated enterprise deals, including pricing, contracts, resource requirements, and engagement economics.

  • Experience selling complex software, AI solutions, technical services, or research-driven solutions to large enterprise customers.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor while providing strategic leadership and direction from day one.

  • Experience owning customer engagements beyond the sale, including implementation, delivery, stakeholder management, and ensuring contractual commitments are met.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand complex AI capabilities, engage credibly with technical stakeholders, and translate customer problems into executable solutions.

  • Ability to work closely with research, engineering, and operations teams to scope engagements, align resources, and deliver against customer expectations.

  • A builder's mindset: you take full ownership, operate independently, move quickly, and create structure where little exists.

  • Exceptional executive presence, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

  • Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment where individual ownership, commercial judgment, and results are essential.

Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

We're particularly interested in candidates who have built and scaled enterprise GTM functions within AI, enterprise software, AI infrastructure, or technical services businesses, as well as commercial leaders who have helped large organizations adopt and implement AI at scale.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Head of Enterprise Sales, VP of GTM, Chief Commercial Officer, or similar leadership roles at high-growth technology companies.

  • Enterprise AI companies selling complex, high-value solutions to frontier AI labs, Fortune 500 companies, or sophisticated enterprise customers.

  • AI implementation and transformation leaders at top management consulting firms (MBB) who have led enterprise AI strategy, deployment, and implementation initiatives, working directly with C-suite stakeholders and translating complex business challenges into technical solutions.

  • AI infrastructure, technical services, or applied research businesses where commercial leaders own both deal structuring and customer delivery.

  • Early-stage companies where the candidate personally generated pipeline, closed strategic accounts, established commercial processes, and built a sales organization.

  • Experience managing large enterprise contracts, complex implementations, and long-term strategic customer relationships.

We particularly value candidates who have personally driven revenue, built executive-level relationships, and owned customer outcomes. This could include traditional enterprise sales leaders as well as consulting leaders who have demonstrated the ability to identify commercial opportunities, lead complex AI engagements, and drive successful enterprise implementations.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

About the role

This is our first accounting hire, reporting to the Head of Finance & Accounting. You will own the close, revenue recognition, cost matching and our first audit, choose the ERP, and build the accounting function AI-native from the start.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get into the weeds and build. You start as the only in-house accountant, working with our fractional accounting team, and grow the team as the function grows. A prior Controller title is not required. We weigh what you have built over the titles you have held.

What you'll do

Own the books

  • Own the general ledger and the monthly close end to end, including reconciliations and journal entry review.

  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for large, non-recurring contracts with acceptance terms.

  • Own the revenue and cost tie-out from delivery and billing data to the ledger.

  • Define cost of goods sold, variable costs and cost matching, including expert and contractor payments and inference.

  • Direct the fractional accounting team on operational accounting, including AR, AP, cash and equity.

  • Own stock-based compensation accounting and 409A coordination with external valuation specialists.

Make the numbers audit-ready

  • Lead the move to accrual-basis US GAAP financials and our first external audit.

  • Build the controls and evidence a first audit requires.

  • Document material accounting judgments in policies and memos.

Build with AI

  • Automate the close with AI and agentic workflows, with review controls that keep it auditable.

  • Run the bake-off for an AI-forward ERP and own the implementation.

  • Set the roadmap for when to automate, outsource to a vendor, or expand headcount.

Support the company

  • Own tax compliance with external tax advisors, including federal and state filings, estimated payments and contractor information reporting.

  • Own the income tax provision and support tax planning, including credits and incentives.

  • Own the monthly financial statements and the accounting package for the board.

  • Review non-standard contracts with commercial legal and Sales before they are signed.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations and People on expert payments and payroll.

  • Build the team as the function grows.

What we're looking for

  • Automation you built that replaced accounting work, with results you can quantify.

  • ASC 606 experience, ideally with services or usage-based revenue and acceptance terms.

  • Independent judgment on accounting policy, backed by memos that hold up with auditors.

  • Cost accounting experience, including cost matching for a contractor or expert workforce.

  • Advise founders on the accounting impact of deals and decisions before they are made.

  • Hands-on experience running a monthly close end to end.

  • A Big Four audit foundation and hands-on industry experience.

  • A builder who can go from a blank page to a running process without slowing the company down.

  • High ownership, low ego, and comfort with direct feedback. You stay accountable for both the monthly grind and the year-long build.

  • Comfortable in a 5-day in-office SF environment that prizes speed and direct feedback.

Bonus

  • Experience on the company side of an audit.

  • ERP selection or implementation, ideally an AI-forward system.

  • Income tax provision (ASC 740) or corporate tax experience.

  • SQL, Python, BigQuery or Claude Code.

  • CPA.

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

About the role

As our first Social Media & Community Manager, you'll build the AfterQuery Experts brand and community from the ground up. You'll turn our growing expert network into a recognizable, engaged community — one that people want to follow, contribute to, and be part of. Across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Reddit, and Discord, you'll own our social strategy, create content that gets people talking, and build meaningful connections with experts where they already spend their time.

This is a true ground-floor opportunity to shape our voice, define our presence, and turn a network of talented people into a community with real momentum.

What you'll do

  • Own our social presence: Build and manage AfterQuery Experts across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Reddit, and Discord, developing a distinct voice and strategy for each platform.

  • Create content people want to engage with: Produce high-quality, high-volume content including short-form videos, carousels, threads, memes, expert spotlights, and behind-the-scenes stories. You'll be hands-on with shooting, editing, and publishing.

  • Build our brand: Develop a recognizable voice, visual identity, and content strategy that makes AfterQuery Experts stand out and gives people a reason to follow us.

  • Grow an engaged community: Show up where experts spend their time, spark conversations, respond to comments and DMs, and build genuine relationships with our expert network.

  • Stay culturally relevant: Keep a pulse on AI, technology, and internet culture. Spot emerging trends, move quickly on relevant moments, and create timely content that feels native to each platform.

  • Turn engagement into growth: Partner with recruiting and growth teams to drive expert awareness, community participation, and sign-ups through organic social.

  • Create community experiences: Organize AMAs, expert spotlights, virtual events, hackathons, and conference activations that bring our community together.

  • Build strategic partnerships: Develop relationships with creators, influencers, university career centers, student organizations, and professional associations to expand our reach.

  • Measure and iterate: Track audience growth, reach, engagement, referral traffic, and expert sign-ups. Use performance insights to continuously improve our content and strategy.

  • Be the voice of our experts: Partner with our expert support team to understand community needs, surface common questions, and turn those insights into useful content and resources.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 2–6 years of experience managing social media, building online communities, or growing an audience for a consumer brand, creator, marketplace, or professional network.

  • A portfolio demonstrating social accounts, campaigns, or communities you've built and grown, ideally with measurable results.

  • Deep familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, and Discord — you understand the culture, formats, and nuances of each platform.

  • Strong creative instincts and hands-on content production skills, including short-form video, editing, and graphic design (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, Canva, Figma, or similar).

  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop a distinctive brand voice and adapt your tone to different audiences and platforms.

  • A strong understanding of what drives online engagement, audience growth, and community participation.

  • Highly proactive and resourceful. You're comfortable taking an idea from concept to execution without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, technology, and the people building and shaping the future of AI.

  • Comfortable working in our San Francisco office five days a week in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

Preferred

  • Experience building communities for data labeling, gig work, freelance, creator-economy, or professional networks.

  • Experience moderating and growing Reddit or Discord communities.

  • Familiarity with social media analytics and scheduling tools such as Sprout Social, Later, Hootsuite, or native platform dashboards.

  • Experience developing creator, influencer, university, or professional association partnerships.

Why AfterQuery

  • Work at the frontier: your experts produce the data that trains and evaluates the world's leading AI models

  • Real ownership from day one — you will define how expert support works here

  • Small, fast-moving team where your findings reach decision-makers the same day

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

About the role

This is our first strategic finance hire, reporting to the Head of Finance & Accounting. You will own planning, budgets and analytics, and build them AI-native from the start, so we run the business off the data and invest in what builds a durable business.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get into the weeds and build. You start as the only person in FP&A, building your own models, data and tools, and grow the team as the function grows. A prior Head of FP&A title is not required. We weigh what you have built over the titles you have held.

What you'll do

Own the plan

  • Own the operating model, the annual plan and the monthly forecast.

  • Set targets and budgets, and help each team understand its headcount and expenses.

  • Build customer- and contract-level unit economics and forecast capacity.

  • Work with teams to optimize fixed and variable costs across experts, inference and compute.

  • Forecast compute and inference spend, and model capacity commitments before we sign them.

  • Own the cash forecast and quarterly tax estimates, so large payments are planned ahead.

Run the business off the data

  • Build the data layer from the ledger, CRM, payroll, spend and delivery systems.

  • Own the metric definitions and the quarterly business review.

  • Deliver budget-vs-actual and variance analysis each month.

  • Partner with Accounting so management reporting ties to the close every month.

Build with AI

  • Automate the planning and reporting cycle with AI and agentic workflows, with checks back to source.

  • Keep the business context encoded so the tools know the business at the start of every cycle.

Support decisions

  • Price new work, run deal reviews and model deal structure with the Delivery, Engagement and Operations teams.

  • Build the business case for new products and verticals before we commit people and spend.

  • Own board and investor materials, and support capital allocation decisions.

What we're looking for

  • Models, data pipelines and AI workflows you built yourself that replaced manual FP&A work, with results you can quantify.

  • Hands-on SQL, Python, Claude Code or Codex experience. You pull your own data and run your own analysis.

  • Comfortable forecasting a business and industry that change quarter to quarter, and updating the assumptions when they do.

  • The judgment to know when an output is wrong.

  • A foundation in investment banking, consulting or strategic finance, and hands-on FP&A at a hyper-growth technology company.

  • You explain the numbers plainly to founders and engineers, and push back with data.

  • High ownership, low ego, and comfort with direct feedback.

  • Comfortable working five days a week in our San Francisco office.

Bonus

  • Modeling a services, usage-based or marketplace business, or inference and compute costs.

  • Building or running a planning process from scratch.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

    ","id":"03ef8c37-eab7-4864-88bc-0e640008ee92","lists":[{"text":"Key Responsibilities:","content":"
  • Prepare aircraft surfaces for painting by cleaning, masking, and sanding areas to remove old paint or contaminants.

  • Follow precise instructions and blueprints to create custom designs, logos, or lettering on aircraft.
  • Inspect painted surfaces for quality, ensuring proper thickness, gloss, and uniformity of color.
  • Repair and touch up paintwork as necessary, ensuring aircraft meet regulatory and aesthetic standards.
  • Maintain and clean painting equipment and tools, ensuring they are in proper working order.
  • Comply with safety regulations, using appropriate protective gear and ensuring the workspace is safe and clean.
  • Record and document all work performed, including materials used and procedures followed.

  • Ensure compliance with environmental regulations regarding the use of chemicals and hazardous materials.

    Ziel dieses Projekts ist es, hochwertige visuelle Aufnahmen von Straßen, wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten und öffentlichen Bereichen in verschiedenen EU-Ländern zu erfassen.     Die Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) ist ein Unternehmen für Felddatenerhebung, das 2017 in Europa gegründet wurde. Wir erfassen Daten dort, wo Automatisierung nicht möglich ist. Wir zählen Merkmale, machen Fotos und Videos, zeichnen Sprache auf und scannen Gebiete bis ins kleinste Detail – damit Sie fundiertere Entscheidungen treffen können. Unsere Teams zur Datenerhebung sind in Europa und Nordamerika im Einsatz und bereit, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen.
     
    Projektübersicht
    Ziel dieses Projekts ist es, hochwertige visuelle Aufnahmen von Straßen, wichtigen Sehenswürdigkeiten und öffentlichen Bereichen in verschiedenen EU-Ländern zu erfassen. Mithilfe von Fahrzeugen, die mit abnehmbaren 360°-Kameras und Lidar-Systemen ausgestattet sind, nehmen die Fahrer umfassende Bilder ihrer Umgebung auf. Die erfassten Daten werden auf bordeigenen Computern (SSD-Laufwerken) gespeichert und später zur Verbesserung einer der führenden Online-Kartenplattformen verwendet.
     
    Die Datensammler folgen vorgegebenen Routen, die sich auf öffentliche Straßen, Geschäftsviertel und Sehenswürdigkeiten konzentrieren. Um die bestmögliche Bildqualität zu gewährleisten, müssen bestimmte Bereiche möglicherweise bei günstigen Wetterbedingungen erneut besucht werden.
    Die Projektdauer variiert je nach Umfang der Datenerhebung im jeweiligen Zielgebiet. In der Regel umfasst der Einsatz eine aktive Arbeitsphase von 3 bis 6 Monaten.
     
    Arbeitszeit:
    Vollzeitbeschäftigung innerhalb der regulären Geschäftszeiten (8:00–19:00 Uhr).
     
    Ablauf des Bewerbungsverfahrens:
    Fahrprüfung zur Verkehrssicherheit, Interview mit einem Recruiter sowie anschließender Onboarding-Prozess.

    Unternehmensbeschreibung

    Die Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) ist ein im Jahr 2017 gegründetes Unternehmen für die Erfassung von Felddaten in Europa.

    Wir sammeln Daten an Orten, wo Automatisierung nicht möglich ist. Wir erfassen Merkmale, erstellen Fotos und Videos, zeichnen Sprache auf und scannen Gebiete nach jedem Detail, das Sie benötigen, um fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Unsere Felddatenerfassungsteams sind in Europa und Nordamerika verteilt und bereit, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen.

    Projektziel

    Das Ziel des Projekts ist es, Bilder von Straßen, Hauptattraktionen und öffentlichen Bereichen in den EU-Ländern zu sammeln. Das Projekt wird in Autos mit 360-Kameras durchgeführt, die auf dem Dach montiert sind und die Umgebung des Fahrzeugs erfassen und diese Bilder auf Computern im Inneren des Fahrzeugs speichern. Später werden diese Daten verwendet, um eine der beliebtesten Online-Karten der Welt zu verbessern.

    Den Datensammlern werden spezifische Routen durch öffentliche Straßen und Bereiche zugewiesen, die gezielt auf Geschäftsviertel und historische Stätten abzielen. Aufgrund schlechter Wetterbedingungen werden einige Gebiete mehrmals besucht, um die bestmögliche Bildqualität zu erfassen. Das Projekt soll zwischen 3 und 6 Monaten dauern und verschiedene Bereiche der Datensammlung abdecken.

    Der ideale Kandidat hat Spaß am Autofahren, kennt die Gegend gut, kennt sich mit Verkehrstrends aus und ist äußerst verantwortungsbewusst und zuverlässig.

    Der Arbeitsplan für das Projekt sieht von Montag bis Freitag 8 Stunden pro Tag, 40 Stunden pro Woche vor. Aufgrund von wetterbedingten Ausfallzeiten ist auch Arbeit an Wochenenden möglich.

    Unternehmensbeschreibung

    Die Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) ist ein im Jahr 2017 gegründetes Unternehmen für die Erfassung von Felddaten in Europa. 

    Wir sammeln Daten an Orten, wo Automatisierung nicht möglich ist. Wir erfassen Merkmale, erstellen Fotos und Videos, zeichnen Sprache auf und scannen Gebiete nach jedem Detail, das Sie benötigen, um fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Unsere Felddatenerfassungsteams sind in Europa und Nordamerika verteilt und bereit, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen.

    Projektziel

    Das Ziel des Projekts ist es, Bilder von Straßen, Hauptattraktionen und öffentlichen Bereichen in den EU-Ländern zu sammeln. Das Projekt wird in Autos mit 360-Kameras durchgeführt, die auf dem Dach montiert sind und die Umgebung des Fahrzeugs erfassen und diese Bilder auf Computern im Inneren des Fahrzeugs speichern. Später werden diese Daten verwendet, um eine der beliebtesten Online-Karten der Welt zu verbessern.

    Den Datensammlern werden spezifische Routen durch öffentliche Straßen und Bereiche zugewiesen, die gezielt auf Geschäftsviertel und historische Stätten abzielen. Aufgrund schlechter Wetterbedingungen werden einige Gebiete mehrmals besucht, um die bestmögliche Bildqualität zu erfassen. Das Projekt soll zwischen 3 und 6 Monaten dauern und verschiedene Bereiche der Datensammlung abdecken.

    Der ideale Kandidat hat Spaß am Autofahren, kennt die Gegend gut, kennt sich mit Verkehrstrends aus und ist äußerst verantwortungsbewusst und zuverlässig.

    Der Arbeitsplan für das Projekt sieht von Montag bis Freitag 8 Stunden pro Tag, 40 Stunden pro Woche vor. Aufgrund von wetterbedingten Ausfallzeiten ist auch Arbeit an Wochenenden möglich.

Company description

Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe. 

We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.

Project objective
The goal of the project is to help collect images of streets, main points of interest and public areas. The project is performed on cars with 360 cameras mounted on top that image the area around the vehicle and store those images on computers inside the vehicle. Later, this data will be used to enhance one the most popular online maps in the world.

The data collectors will be given specific routes around public streets and areas, specifically targeting commercial districts and historical sites. Due to poor weather conditions some areas will be visited multiple times in order to collect the best quality of imaging. The project is expected to last at least 8 months and will cover different city/state zones.

The ideal candidate enjoys driving, knows well the area, traffic trends, is highly responsible and reliable.

The schedule expected on the project is Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day 40 hours per week. You can work more than 8 hours if you will.

    Company description

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe. 

    We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.

    Project objective
    The goal of the project is to help collect images of streets, main points of interest and public areas. The project is performed on cars with 360 cameras mounted on top that image the area around the vehicle and store those images on computers inside the vehicle. Later, this data will be used to enhance one the most popular online maps in the world.

    The data collectors will be given specific routes around public streets and areas, specifically targeting commercial districts and historical sites. Due to poor weather conditions some areas will be visited multiple times in order to collect the best quality of imaging. The project is expected to last at least 8 months and will cover different city/state zones.

    The ideal candidate enjoys driving, knows well the area, traffic trends, is highly responsible and reliable.

    The schedule expected on the project is Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day 40 hours per week. You can work more than 8 hours if you will.

    About the Role

    We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Inventory Coordinator to support inventory operations, logistics coordination, and material tracking across field and operational teams.

    In this role, you will act as a key connection point between field operations, logistics, procurement, and repair teams, ensuring materials and equipment are accurately tracked, distributed, and maintained throughout their lifecycle.     ","id":"ed880931-757b-4dd3-82ef-db3f4dcb8ce2","lists":[{"text":"Key Responsibilities","content":"

    Logistics & Distribution

  • Coordinate inbound and outbound material movements for field repairs, refurbishments, upgrades, and operational builds
  • Work closely with logistics teams to ensure accurate routing and timely delivery of materials
  • Communicate material usage, inventory status, and disposition requirements
  • Request production orders and support operational material allocation changes
  • Coordinate material transfers between repair stations, hubs, and field locations
  • Manage material disposition and inventory handling processes

    • Systems & Inventory Management

  • Maintain and update inventory and material records in internal inventory management systems
  • Monitor inventory dashboards and initiate corrective actions when discrepancies are identified
  • Update systems to reflect material movement between repair stations, hubs, and field operations
  • Review inventory minimum and maximum stock levels to support regional operational requirements
  • Assist with troubleshooting and resolving inventory system-related issues
  • Ensure inventory data accuracy and operational compliance

    • Procurement & Project Support

  • Coordinate material distribution requests from operational and project teams
  • Work with procurement teams to support production builds and supply requests
  • Support creation and maintenance of BOM (Bill of Materials) configurations for project-specific requirements
  • Maintain operational checklists and collaborate with teams on packaging and equipment handling improvements
  • Review process documentation and communicate workflow updates to relevant stakeholders

    • Inventory Audits & Forecasting

  • Manage equipment inventory and support spare parts forecasting activities
  • Monitor inventory availability across hubs, service centers, and field locations
  • Escalate projected shortages and support inventory planning activities
  • Assist logistics teams with cycle counts and inventory audits
  • Support bi-annual and annual physical inventory counts across operational facilities and partner locations

    • Material Handling Scope

    The role requires a strong understanding of inventory classification and material usage, including:

  • Field replaceable units (FRUs)
  • Sensor platform equipment
  • Production and repair components
  • Raw materials and prototyping assets
  • Expense and operational inventory items
  • Third-party equipment used alongside operational assets

    Yrityksen kuvaus

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) on kenttätietojen keräämiseen erikoistunut yritys, joka on perustettu vuonna 2017 Euroopassa. Keräämme tietoja paikoista, joissa automaatio ei ole mahdollista. Laskemme ominaisuuksia, otamme valokuvia, teemme videoita, äänitämme puhetta ja skannaamme alueita, jotta saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon parempien päätösten tekemiseksi. Kenttätietojen keräystiimimme ovat hajautettuina ympäri Eurooppaa ja Pohjois-Amerikkaa, valmiina ottamaan vastaan uusia haasteita.

    Projektin tavoite

    Projektin tavoitteena on auttaa keräämään kuvia kaduista, tärkeimmistä kiinnostavista kohteista ja julkisista alueista EU-maissa. Projekti toteutetaan autoilla, joihin on kiinnitetty 360 asteen irrotettavat kamerat, jotka kuljettaja asentaa ajoneuvon katolle. Kamerat kuvaavat ajoneuvon ympärillä olevaa aluetta ja tallentavat nämä kuvat ajoneuvon sisällä oleviin tietokoneisiin. Myöhemmin näitä tietoja käytetään parantamaan yhtä maailman suosituimmista online-kartoista.

    Tietojen kerääjille annetaan tietyt reitit julkisilla kaduilla ja alueilla, erityisesti kaupallisilla alueilla ja historiallisilla kohteilla. Huonojen sääolosuhteiden vuoksi joillakin alueilla käydään useita kertoja parhaan kuvanlaadun saavuttamiseksi. Projektin odotetaan kestävän 3-6 kuukautta ja kattavan useita eri tietojenkeruualueita.

    Ihanteellinen hakija nauttii ajamisesta, tuntee alueen ja liikenteen suuntaukset hyvin, on erittäin vastuullinen ja luotettava. Projektin työaikataulu on maanantaista perjantaihin, 8 tuntia päivässä, 40 tuntia viikossa. Sääolosuhteiden aiheuttamien keskeytysten vuoksi työskentelyä saattaa olla myös viikonloppuisin.

    Yrityksen kuvaus

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) on kenttätietojen keräämiseen erikoistunut yritys, joka on perustettu vuonna 2017 Euroopassa. Keräämme tietoja paikoista, joissa automaatio ei ole mahdollista. Laskemme ominaisuuksia, otamme valokuvia, teemme videoita, äänitämme puhetta ja skannaamme alueita, jotta saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon parempien päätösten tekemiseksi. Kenttätietojen keräystiimimme ovat hajautettuina ympäri Eurooppaa ja Pohjois-Amerikkaa, valmiina ottamaan vastaan uusia haasteita.

    Projektin tavoite

    Projektin tavoitteena on auttaa keräämään kuvia kaduista, tärkeimmistä kiinnostavista kohteista ja julkisista alueista EU-maissa. Projekti toteutetaan autoilla, joihin on kiinnitetty 360 asteen irrotettavat kamerat, jotka kuljettaja asentaa ajoneuvon katolle. Kamerat kuvaavat ajoneuvon ympärillä olevaa aluetta ja tallentavat nämä kuvat ajoneuvon sisällä oleviin tietokoneisiin. Myöhemmin näitä tietoja käytetään parantamaan yhtä maailman suosituimmista online-kartoista.

    Tietojen kerääjille annetaan tietyt reitit julkisilla kaduilla ja alueilla, erityisesti kaupallisilla alueilla ja historiallisilla kohteilla. Huonojen sääolosuhteiden vuoksi joillakin alueilla käydään useita kertoja parhaan kuvanlaadun saavuttamiseksi. Projektin odotetaan kestävän 3-6 kuukautta ja kattavan useita eri tietojenkeruualueita.

    Ihanteellinen hakija nauttii ajamisesta, tuntee alueen ja liikenteen suuntaukset hyvin, on erittäin vastuullinen ja luotettava. Projektin työaikataulu on maanantaista perjantaihin, 8 tuntia päivässä, 40 tuntia viikossa. Sääolosuhteiden aiheuttamien keskeytysten vuoksi työskentelyä saattaa olla myös viikonloppuisin.

    Yrityksen kuvaus

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) on kenttätietojen keräämiseen erikoistunut yritys, joka on perustettu vuonna 2017 Euroopassa. Keräämme tietoja paikoista, joissa automaatio ei ole mahdollista. Laskemme ominaisuuksia, otamme valokuvia, teemme videoita, äänitämme puhetta ja skannaamme alueita, jotta saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon parempien päätösten tekemiseksi. Kenttätietojen keräystiimimme ovat hajautettuina ympäri Eurooppaa ja Pohjois-Amerikkaa, valmiina ottamaan vastaan uusia haasteita.

    Projektin tavoite

    Projektin tavoitteena on auttaa keräämään kuvia kaduista, tärkeimmistä kiinnostavista kohteista ja julkisista alueista EU-maissa. Projekti toteutetaan autoilla, joihin on kiinnitetty 360 asteen irrotettavat kamerat, jotka kuljettaja asentaa ajoneuvon katolle. Kamerat kuvaavat ajoneuvon ympärillä olevaa aluetta ja tallentavat nämä kuvat ajoneuvon sisällä oleviin tietokoneisiin. Myöhemmin näitä tietoja käytetään parantamaan yhtä maailman suosituimmista online-kartoista.

    Tietojen kerääjille annetaan tietyt reitit julkisilla kaduilla ja alueilla, erityisesti kaupallisilla alueilla ja historiallisilla kohteilla. Huonojen sääolosuhteiden vuoksi joillakin alueilla käydään useita kertoja parhaan kuvanlaadun saavuttamiseksi. Projektin odotetaan kestävän 3-6 kuukautta ja kattavan useita eri tietojenkeruualueita.

    Ihanteellinen hakija nauttii ajamisesta, tuntee alueen ja liikenteen suuntaukset hyvin, on erittäin vastuullinen ja luotettava. Projektin työaikataulu on maanantaista perjantaihin, 8 tuntia päivässä, 40 tuntia viikossa. Sääolosuhteiden aiheuttamien keskeytysten vuoksi työskentelyä saattaa olla myös viikonloppuisin.

    Yrityksen kuvaus

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) on kenttätietojen keräämiseen erikoistunut yritys, joka on perustettu vuonna 2017 Euroopassa. Keräämme tietoja paikoista, joissa automaatio ei ole mahdollista. Laskemme ominaisuuksia, otamme valokuvia, teemme videoita, äänitämme puhetta ja skannaamme alueita, jotta saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon parempien päätösten tekemiseksi. Kenttätietojen keräystiimimme ovat hajautettuina ympäri Eurooppaa ja Pohjois-Amerikkaa, valmiina ottamaan vastaan uusia haasteita.

    Projektin tavoite

    Projektin tavoitteena on auttaa keräämään kuvia kaduista, tärkeimmistä kiinnostavista kohteista ja julkisista alueista EU-maissa. Kamerat kuvaavat ajoneuvon ympärillä olevaa aluetta ja tallentavat nämä kuvat ajoneuvon sisällä oleviin tietokoneisiin. Myöhemmin näitä tietoja käytetään parantamaan yhtä maailman suosituimmista online-kartoista.

    Tietojen kerääjille annetaan tietyt reitit julkisilla kaduilla ja alueilla, erityisesti kaupallisilla alueilla ja historiallisilla kohteilla. Huonojen sääolosuhteiden vuoksi joillakin alueilla käydään useita kertoja parhaan kuvanlaadun saavuttamiseksi. Projektin odotetaan kestävän 3-6 kuukautta ja kattavan useita eri tietojenkeruualueita.

    Ihanteellinen hakija nauttii ajamisesta, tuntee alueen ja liikenteen suuntaukset hyvin, on erittäin vastuullinen ja luotettava. Projektin työaikataulu on maanantaista perjantaihin, 8 tuntia päivässä, 40 tuntia viikossa. Sääolosuhteiden aiheuttamien keskeytysten vuoksi työskentelyä saattaa olla myös viikonloppuisin.

    Yrityksen kuvaus

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) on kenttätietojen keräämiseen erikoistunut yritys, joka on perustettu vuonna 2017 Euroopassa. Keräämme tietoja paikoista, joissa automaatio ei ole mahdollista. Laskemme ominaisuuksia, otamme valokuvia, teemme videoita, äänitämme puhetta ja skannaamme alueita, jotta saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon parempien päätösten tekemiseksi. Kenttätietojen keräystiimimme ovat hajautettuina ympäri Eurooppaa ja Pohjois-Amerikkaa, valmiina ottamaan vastaan uusia haasteita.

    Projektin tavoite

    Projektin tavoitteena on auttaa keräämään kuvia kaduista, tärkeimmistä kiinnostavista kohteista ja julkisista alueista EU-maissa. Projekti toteutetaan autoilla, joihin on kiinnitetty 360 asteen irrotettavat kamerat, jotka kuljettaja asentaa ajoneuvon katolle. Kamerat kuvaavat ajoneuvon ympärillä olevaa aluetta ja tallentavat nämä kuvat ajoneuvon sisällä oleviin tietokoneisiin. Myöhemmin näitä tietoja käytetään parantamaan yhtä maailman suosituimmista online-kartoista.

    Tietojen kerääjille annetaan tietyt reitit julkisilla kaduilla ja alueilla, erityisesti kaupallisilla alueilla ja historiallisilla kohteilla. Huonojen sääolosuhteiden vuoksi joillakin alueilla käydään useita kertoja parhaan kuvanlaadun saavuttamiseksi. Projektin odotetaan kestävän 3-6 kuukautta ja kattavan useita eri tietojenkeruualueita.

    Ihanteellinen hakija nauttii ajamisesta, tuntee alueen ja liikenteen suuntaukset hyvin, on erittäin vastuullinen ja luotettava. Projektin työaikataulu on maanantaista perjantaihin, 8 tuntia päivässä, 40 tuntia viikossa. Sääolosuhteiden aiheuttamien keskeytysten vuoksi työskentelyä saattaa olla myös viikonloppuisin.

Due to poor weather conditions some areas will be visited multiple times in order to collect the best quality of imaging.     The ideal candidate enjoys driving, knows well the area, traffic trends, is highly responsible and reliable.

    The schedule expected on the project is Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day 40 hours per week. You can work more than 8 hours if you will.

    Descripción de la Empresa

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) es una empresa de recolección de datos fundada en 2017 en Europa. 

    Recopilamos datos donde la automatización no es posible. Nuestros equipos de recolección de datos de campo están repartidos por Europa y América del Norte, listos para aceptar nuevos desafíos.

    Objetivo del Proyecto

    El objetivo del proyecto es realizar una encuesta de campo para las estaciones de Ciudad de México con el fin de mejorar el servicio de mapeo.

    La Tarea

    A los recolectores de datos se les asignarán estaciones específicas cada día a las que deberán asistir. El operador utilizará un dispositivo de trabajo para escanear los principales atributos en la estación. Por lo tanto, buscamos a alguien que sea activo y le guste visitar nuevos lugares.

    Duración

    Esperamos que el proyecto dure un mínimo de 3 meses.

    Horario

    El horario es de lunes a viernes, 8 horas al día, 40 horas a la semana.

    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) es una empresa de recolección de datos fundada en 2017 en Europa. 

    Recopilamos datos donde la automatización no es posible.     El objetivo del proyecto es realizar una encuesta de campo para las estaciones de Ciudad de México con el fin de mejorar el servicio de mapeo.

    Duración

    Esperamos que el proyecto dure un mínimo de 3 meses.

    Horario

    El horario es de lunes a viernes, 8 horas al día, 40 horas a la semana.

    We are seeking skilled Repair Technicians / Hardware Support Engineers to support hardware repair, refurbishment, maintenance, and operational activities across repair centers and field operations.

","description":"

    À propos du poste

    Nous recherchons un Responsable des opérations véhicules autonomes (AVOS / Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead) pour superviser les opérations quotidiennes de flottes de véhicules autonomes (AV) et de robotaxis soutenant les programmes de test, les services commerciaux de ride-hailing autonome et les new city launches en Europe.

    En tant que leader opérationnel au sein du depot, vous coordonnerez les Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, Senior Technicians et SDS Specialists afin de garantir que les véhicules restent sûrs, opérationnels et prêts au déploiement. Vous jouerez un rôle critique dans la disponibilité de la flotte, l’atteinte des KPIs opérationnels et le lancement puis la montée en charge de flottes autonomes.

    Ce poste convient aux candidats ayant une expérience en fleet operations, services de mobilité, opérations automobiles, logistique ou transport, et qui aiment diriger des équipes dans des environnements rapides et technologiques.

    ","id":"2df5d631-bf3a-4efc-970a-044481e25f0c","lists":[{"text":"Responsabilités clés","content":"

    Gestion des opérations de flotte

  • Diriger les opérations quotidiennes de flottes de véhicules autonomes et robotaxi sur un ou plusieurs dépôts.
  • Garantir que les véhicules sont prêts pour les tests, le déploiement commercial et les services de ride-hailing autonome.
  • Surveiller fleet utilization, disponibilité des véhicules, plannings de recharge et readiness opérationnelle.
  • Coordonner les activités quotidiennes de dispatch et retour des véhicules pour maximiser l’efficacité de la flotte.
  • Réduire le downtime grâce à une planification et une coordination opérationnelles efficaces.

    • Opérations de dépôt

  • Superviser toutes les activités du depot robotaxi en garantissant des opérations sûres, efficaces et organisées.
  • Coordonner le travail des Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, Senior Technicians et SDS Specialists.
  • S’assurer que les véhicules répondent aux standards de propreté, recharge, inspection et maintenance avant déploiement.
  • Soutenir la mise en place de dépôts et la readiness opérationnelle pour les new city launches et l’expansion de flotte.

    • Leadership d’équipe

  • Recruter, onboarder, former et superviser le personnel opérationnel.
  • Créer les plannings de shifts soutenant des opérations de flotte 24/7.
  • Réaliser les revues de performance et séances de coaching.
  • Promouvoir une culture de sécurité, responsabilité et amélioration continue.
  • Veiller à ce que tous les membres de l’équipe respectent les procédures opérationnelles et standards de sécurité.

    • Gestion client et parties prenantes

  • Agir comme point de contact opérationnel principal pour les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Coordonner les activités quotidiennes avec les équipes engineering, product, technical et fleet management.
  • Préparer les rapports opérationnels, KPI dashboards et résumés de performance.
  • Escalader les risques opérationnels et élaborer des plans de mitigation.
  • Soutenir les visites client, audits et revues opérationnelles.

    • Excellence opérationnelle

  • Surveiller les KPIs, notamment fleet availability, vehicle uptime, dispatch efficiency, depot productivity et operational quality.
  • Identifier les opportunités d’amélioration des processus afin de réduire le downtime et améliorer la performance de la flotte.
  • Développer et mettre en œuvre des SOPs pour les opérations de véhicules autonomes.
  • Soutenir les initiatives d’amélioration continue pendant le robotaxi fleet scaling et le déploiement commercial.

    • Santé, sécurité et conformité

  • Garantir la conformité aux politiques de l’entreprise, réglementations locales et procédures opérationnelles.
  • Promouvoir une forte culture sécurité au sein de toutes les équipes.
  • Veiller à ce que les incidents soient correctement analysés, documentés et résolus.
  • Maintenir la conformité aux exigences health & safety liées aux opérations de flotte et de dépôt.
    • "},{"text":"Exigences","content":"

    Essentielles

  • Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en fleet operations, opérations automobiles, transport, logistique, services de mobilité ou environnements opérationnels similaires.
  • Expérience préalable de leadership d’équipes opérationnelles ou techniques.
  • Expérience en gestion d’opérations par shifts ou 24/7.
  • Solides compétences en leadership et gestion d’équipe.
  • Excellentes capacités d’organisation et de planification.
  • Expérience du suivi des KPIs et de la performance opérationnelle.
  • Solides compétences de communication et stakeholder management.
  • Anglais courant.

    • Souhaitées

  • Expérience avec véhicules autonomes, flottes robotaxi, programmes ADAS ou tests automobiles.
  • Expérience en opérations de flottes EV.
  • Expérience de lancement de nouveaux sites opérationnels ou dépôts.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de fleet management et outils de reporting opérationnel.
  • Langues européennes supplémentaires selon le pays du projet.
    • "},{"text":"Profil recherché","content":"

    Les AV Operations Leads performants combinent excellence opérationnelle, leadership fort et intérêt pour les technologies de mobilité émergentes.

    Vous savez coordonner personnes, véhicules, dépôts et processus tout en maintenant les plus hauts standards de sécurité, efficacité et satisfaction client. Vous aimez résoudre les défis opérationnels lorsque les flottes de véhicules autonomes s’étendent vers de nouvelles villes et de nouveaux marchés.

    Qu’il s’agisse de pilotes ou d’opérations robotaxi pleinement commerciales, vous veillerez à ce que chaque véhicule, chaque shift et chaque membre de l’équipe contribue à un service de mobilité autonome sûr et fiable.

  • Développement de carrière à long terme en fleet management, mobilité autonome et robotaxi operations.
  • Projets internationaux soutenant des programmes de véhicules autonomes de premier plan.
  • Onboarding complet et développement professionnel continu.

    Gestion des opérations de flotte

  • Diriger les opérations quotidiennes de flottes de véhicules autonomes et robotaxi sur un ou plusieurs dépôts.
  • Garantir que les véhicules sont prêts pour les tests, le déploiement commercial et les services de ride-hailing autonome.
  • Surveiller fleet utilization, disponibilité des véhicules, plannings de recharge et readiness opérationnelle.
  • Coordonner les activités quotidiennes de dispatch et retour des véhicules pour maximiser l’efficacité de la flotte.
  • Réduire le downtime grâce à une planification et une coordination opérationnelles efficaces.

    • Opérations de dépôt

  • Superviser toutes les activités du depot robotaxi en garantissant des opérations sûres, efficaces et organisées.
  • Coordonner le travail des Depot Specialists, Safety Operators, Senior Technicians et SDS Specialists.
  • S’assurer que les véhicules répondent aux standards de propreté, recharge, inspection et maintenance avant déploiement.
  • Soutenir la mise en place de dépôts et la readiness opérationnelle pour les new city launches et l’expansion de flotte.

    • Leadership d’équipe

  • Recruter, onboarder, former et superviser le personnel opérationnel.
  • Créer les plannings de shifts soutenant des opérations de flotte 24/7.
  • Réaliser les revues de performance et séances de coaching.
  • Promouvoir une culture de sécurité, responsabilité et amélioration continue.
  • Veiller à ce que tous les membres de l’équipe respectent les procédures opérationnelles et standards de sécurité.

    • Gestion client et parties prenantes

  • Agir comme point de contact opérationnel principal pour les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Coordonner les activités quotidiennes avec les équipes engineering, product, technical et fleet management.
  • Préparer les rapports opérationnels, KPI dashboards et résumés de performance.
  • Escalader les risques opérationnels et élaborer des plans de mitigation.
  • Soutenir les visites client, audits et revues opérationnelles.

    • Excellence opérationnelle

  • Surveiller les KPIs, notamment fleet availability, vehicle uptime, dispatch efficiency, depot productivity et operational quality.
  • Identifier les opportunités d’amélioration des processus afin de réduire le downtime et améliorer la performance de la flotte.
  • Développer et mettre en œuvre des SOPs pour les opérations de véhicules autonomes.
  • Soutenir les initiatives d’amélioration continue pendant le robotaxi fleet scaling et le déploiement commercial.

    • Santé, sécurité et conformité

  • Garantir la conformité aux politiques de l’entreprise, réglementations locales et procédures opérationnelles.
  • Promouvoir une forte culture sécurité au sein de toutes les équipes.
  • Veiller à ce que les incidents soient correctement analysés, documentés et résolus.
  • Maintenir la conformité aux exigences health & safety liées aux opérations de flotte et de dépôt.

    Nous recherchons un Responsable des opérations véhicules autonomes (AVOS / Autonomous Vehicle Operations Lead) pour superviser les opérations quotidiennes de flottes de véhicules autonomes (AV) et de robotaxis soutenant les programmes de test, les services commerciaux de ride-hailing autonome et les new city launches en Europe.

    Gestion des opérations de flotte

  • Garantir que les véhicules sont prêts pour les tests, le déploiement commercial et les services de ride-hailing autonome.

  • Réduire le downtime grâce à une planification et une coordination opérationnelles efficaces.

    • Opérations de dépôt

  • Superviser toutes les activités du depot robotaxi en garantissant des opérations sûres, efficaces et organisées.

  • S’assurer que les véhicules répondent aux standards de propreté, recharge, inspection et maintenance avant déploiement.
  • Soutenir la mise en place de dépôts et la readiness opérationnelle pour les new city launches et l’expansion de flotte.

    • Leadership d’équipe

  • Recruter, onboarder, former et superviser le personnel opérationnel.
  • Créer les plannings de shifts soutenant des opérations de flotte 24/7.

  • Promouvoir une culture de sécurité, responsabilité et amélioration continue.

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre des SOPs pour les opérations de véhicules autonomes.
  • Soutenir les initiatives d’amélioration continue pendant le robotaxi fleet scaling et le déploiement commercial.

    • Santé, sécurité et conformité

  • Garantir la conformité aux politiques de l’entreprise, réglementations locales et procédures opérationnelles.

  • Veiller à ce que les incidents soient correctement analysés, documentés et résolus.
  • Maintenir la conformité aux exigences health & safety liées aux opérations de flotte et de dépôt.

    Popis společnosti
    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) je společnost specializující se na sběr dat v terénu, založená v roce 2017 v Evropě.

    Sbíráme data tam, kde automatizace není možná. Počítáme rysy, pořizujeme fotografie, natáčíme videa, nahráváme řeč a skenujeme oblasti pro každý detail, který potřebujete k tomu, abyste mohli učinit lépe informovaná rozhodnutí. Naše týmy pro sběr dat v terénu jsou rozprostřeny po Evropě a Severní Americe, připravené přijmout nové výzvy.

    Cíl projektu
    Cílem projektu je pomoci se sběrem obrázků ulic, hlavních zajímavých míst a veřejných prostor v zemích EU. Projekt se provádí na vozech s 360 kamery namontovanými na střechu, které snímají oblast kolem vozidla a ukládají tyto obrázky do počítačů uvnitř vozidla. Tato data budou později použita k vylepšení jedné z nejpopulárnějších online map ve světě.

    Sběrači dat dostanou specifické trasy po veřejných ulicích a oblastech, které cílí zejména na obchodní čtvrti a historická místa. Kvůli špatným povětrnostním podmínkám budou některé oblasti navštěvovány opakovaně, aby byla zajištěna nejlepší kvalita obrazování. Očekává se, že projekt potrvá minimálně 3 měsíce a pokryje různé městské/státní zóny.

    Ideální kandidát má rád řízení, dobře zná oblast, dopravní trendy, je velmi zodpovědný a spolehlivý.

    Očekávaný harmonogram projektu je od pondělí do pátku, 8 hodin/den, 40 hodin týdně. Můžete pracovat více než 8 hodin, pokud budete chtít.

    Popis společnosti
    Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) je společnost specializující se na sběr dat v terénu, založená v roce 2017 v Evropě.

    Sbíráme data tam, kde automatizace není možná. Počítáme rysy, pořizujeme fotografie, natáčíme videa, nahráváme řeč a skenujeme oblasti pro každý detail, který potřebujete k tomu, abyste mohli učinit lépe informovaná rozhodnutí. Naše týmy pro sběr dat v terénu jsou rozprostřeny po Evropě a Severní Americe, připravené přijmout nové výzvy.

    Cíl projektu
    Cílem projektu je pomoci se sběrem obrázků ulic, hlavních zajímavých míst a veřejných prostor v zemích EU. Projekt se provádí na vozech s 360 kamery namontovanými na střechu, které snímají oblast kolem vozidla a ukládají tyto obrázky do počítačů uvnitř vozidla. Tato data budou později použita k vylepšení jedné z nejpopulárnějších online map ve světě.

    Sběrači dat dostanou specifické trasy po veřejných ulicích a oblastech, které cílí zejména na obchodní čtvrti a historická místa. Kvůli špatným povětrnostním podmínkám budou některé oblasti navštěvovány opakovaně, aby byla zajištěna nejlepší kvalita obrazování. Očekává se, že projekt potrvá minimálně 3 měsíce a pokryje různé městské/státní zóny.

    Ideální kandidát má rád řízení, dobře zná oblast, dopravní trendy, je velmi zodpovědný a spolehlivý.

    Očekávaný harmonogram projektu je od pondělí do pátku, 8 hodin/den, 40 hodin týdně. Můžete pracovat více než 8 hodin, pokud budete chtít.

    Role Overview

    Our client is an early-stage robotics company based in San Francisco that develops AI models to control robots and tests them on real robotic systems in the lab.

    As a Robot Wrangler, you will support the day-to-day operation of these robots. You will run tests of AI models, monitor the robot during operation, stop the test if something goes wrong, and accurately record the results.

    You may also collect training data by manually controlling the robot. No degree or previous robotics experience is required — you will receive training on the equipment, software, and procedures needed for the role.

    ","id":"801fa039-a184-4a6c-b5b4-c7fbe41e5d3a","lists":[{"text":"What you will do","content":"
  • Run model tests. Download the latest model from cloud storage. Start test runs from the Linux command line.
  • Reset the scene between trials, and record whether each trial succeeded or failed.
  • Move files. Copy models onto the robot's computer. Upload logs, videos, and results to cloud storage (AWS S3
    or similar).
  • Keep people and equipment safe. Watch the robot during every run. Press the emergency stop the moment it
    does something unexpected.
  • Set up and maintain the robots. Stage equipment before each session. Power robots on and off, check cables
    and cameras, and run basic calibration steps.
  • Keep records current. Log each session. Update our written procedures when a step changes.
    • "},{"text":"How you'll succeed","content":"
  • Read the procedure before each session. Ask questions before you start, not during.
  • Keep up with procedure changes for the systems you use most.
  • Arrive on time, with enough time to set up.
  • Keep the lab clean and organized so the data stays accurate.
  • Switch tasks quickly when a robot is down. Use downtime for setup, documentation, or other projects.
    • "},{"text":"What we're looking for","content":"
  • Basic Linux command-line skills: running commands, moving between folders, and copying files between
    machines.
  • Stays alert during repetitive work and reacts quickly when something goes wrong.
  • Follows written procedures exactly and notices when a result looks off.
  • Clear written communication. You can describe a problem on Slack so an engineer understands it the first time.
  • Works independently once trained, and asks questions early when unsure.
  • Reliable. We want someone who will stay in this role long term.
  • Comfortable standing and moving around the lab for most of the day.
  • Able to work on-site in San Francisco full-time.
    • "},{"text":"Nice to have","content":"
  • Experience collecting robot training data by teleoperation (VR headsets, leader-follower arms, or similar). You
    may also do this here.
  • Familiarity with cloud storage and tools, such as AWS S3 or the AWS command line.
  • Can troubleshoot simple hardware and software problems, and write bug reports an engineer can act on.
  • Data collection work in robotics, autonomous driving, or AI.
  • Past work as a robot operator, lab technician, or hardware test technician.
  • Some Python or shell scripting.
  • Experience with robot arms or ROS.
  • Interest in joining team standups and suggesting ways to make testing and data collection faster.

    Project Overview

    We are building a robotics data collection lab focused on bimanual manipulation and embodied AI datasets. We are looking for a Robotics & Computer Vision Integration Engineer to help design, integrate, and validate synchronized sensor and robotics data collection systems.

    In this role, you will work with cameras, depth sensors, IMUs, 6DoF tracking systems, and robotic or handheld grippers to build reliable, repeatable data collection rigs. You will be responsible for hardware and software integration, sensor calibration and synchronization, coordinate-frame alignment, data logging, and collection workflow validation.

    What We’re Looking For

    We are looking for someone who is comfortable moving between hardware integration, robotics software, and data quality validation. The ideal candidate is hands-on, technically curious, and able to diagnose problems across the full sensor-to-dataset pipeline.

    Experience building or maintaining real-world robotics systems is especially valuable, as the role requires turning individual sensors and components into a stable, synchronized, and repeatable data collection system.

    ","id":"ad0e4f1a-42a0-4e89-a727-f20268e03296","lists":[{"text":"Key Responsibilities","content":"
  • Integrate RGB/RGB-D cameras, depth sensors, IMUs, 6DoF trackers, and robotic/handheld grippers into data collection rigs.
  • Configure and validate multi-sensor systems for synchronized data capture.
  • Perform camera calibration, sensor calibration, and coordinate-frame alignment.
  • Configure and maintain ROS/ROS2 pipelines for sensor integration and data collection.
  • Implement and maintain data logging workflows using ROS bags, MCAP, or similar formats.
  • Develop tools and scripts in Python and/or C++ for system integration, testing, and data validation.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and synchronization issues across the collection setup.
  • Validate sensor data quality, timestamps, coordinate transforms, and system performance.
  • Develop repeatable data collection and validation workflows for robotics and embodied AI datasets.
  • Document system configurations, calibration procedures, troubleshooting steps, and collection protocols.
  • Collaborate with robotics, computer vision, and data collection teams to improve the reliability and scalability of the lab setup.
    • "},{"text":"Required Qualifications","content":"
  • Professional experience with robotics, computer vision, sensor integration, or related engineering fields.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++.
  • Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS2.
  • Experience working with RGB/RGB-D cameras and depth sensors.
  • Understanding of camera calibration and coordinate transformations.
  • Experience with IMUs and/or 6DoF tracking systems.
  • Comfortable working in a Linux environment.
  • Experience with Git and standard software development workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work hands-on with both hardware and software.
  • Basic understanding of SLAM, VIO, or related localization/visual tracking concepts.
    • "},{"text":"Nice to Have","content":"

    Experience with any of the following will be considered a strong advantage:

  • OAK-D
  • Intel RealSense
  • ZED cameras
  • VIVE / SteamVR / OpenXR

    Project Overview

    We are building a robotics data collection lab focused on bimanual manipulation and embodied AI datasets. We are looking for a Robotics & Computer Vision Integration Engineer to help design, integrate, and validate synchronized sensor and robotics data collection systems.

    In this role, you will work with cameras, depth sensors, IMUs, 6DoF tracking systems, and robotic or handheld grippers to build reliable, repeatable data collection rigs. You will be responsible for hardware and software integration, sensor calibration and synchronization, coordinate-frame alignment, data logging, and collection workflow validation.

    What We’re Looking For

    We are looking for someone who is comfortable moving between hardware integration, robotics software, and data quality validation. The ideal candidate is hands-on, technically curious, and able to diagnose problems across the full sensor-to-dataset pipeline.

    Experience building or maintaining real-world robotics systems is especially valuable, as the role requires turning individual sensors and components into a stable, synchronized, and repeatable data collection system.

","description":"

    SDS Specialist - Autonomous Vehicle Diagnostics & Calibration

    About the Role

    We are looking for a Self-Driving Systems Specialist (SDS Specialist) to support the diagnostics, calibration, configuration, and technical readiness of self-driving systems used in autonomous vehicles and robotaxi fleets across Europe.

    The SDS Specialist focuses on the technology layer of autonomous mobility: sensors, compute systems, software configurations, autonomous driving hardware, system diagnostics, calibration procedures, and technical validation. This role ensures that the self-driving system installed in each autonomous vehicle is functioning correctly, accurately calibrated, and ready to support safe testing, commercial deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing operations.

    You will work closely with Senior Technicians, AV Operations Leads, Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to identify technical issues, execute structured troubleshooting procedures, and support reliable operation of autonomous vehicle platforms.

    This position is ideal for candidates with experience in automotive electronics, ADAS systems, embedded systems, robotics, diagnostics, calibration, or complex technical support who want to work at the center of autonomous vehicle deployment and robotaxi operations.

    ","id":"064a89eb-07e9-4742-9466-b90c17b224f8","lists":[{"text":"Key Responsibilities","content":"

    Self-Driving System Diagnostics

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot self-driving system issues affecting autonomous vehicle performance and fleet readiness.
  • Investigate technical problems related to cameras, LiDAR, radar, GPS/GNSS, compute units, sensors, connectivity modules, wiring, and autonomous driving hardware.

    About the Role

    We are looking for a Self-Driving Systems Specialist (SDS Specialist) to support the diagnostics, calibration, configuration, and technical readiness of self-driving systems used in autonomous vehicles and robotaxi fleets across Europe.

    Self-Driving System Diagnostics

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot self-driving system issues affecting autonomous vehicle performance and fleet readiness.
  • Investigate technical problems related to cameras, LiDAR, radar, GPS/GNSS, compute units, sensors, connectivity modules, wiring, and autonomous driving hardware.
  • Execute structured diagnostic procedures to identify root causes of SDS hardware, software, and configuration issues.
  • Support advanced troubleshooting for autonomous vehicle faults that impact testing, commercial operations, or robotaxi fleet availability.
  • Escalate complex technical cases to engineering teams with clear findings and supporting documentation.

    • Hardware Support

  • Inspect, repair, replace, and validate SDS hardware components installed on autonomous vehicles.
  • Support installation and verification of cameras, LiDAR units, radar sensors, compute hardware, sensor mounts, antennas, and related components.
  • Confirm that autonomous driving hardware is correctly installed, secured, clean, functional, and ready for operation.
  • Collaborate with Senior Technicians on vehicle-level issues involving both standard automotive systems and SDS components.
  • Ensure all hardware work is completed according to strict safety, quality, and technical procedures.

    • Software Configuration & Updates

  • Perform software updates, configuration changes, and system validation checks for autonomous driving systems.
  • Execute defined software procedures using diagnostic tools, command-line tools, configuration files, or engineering-provided workflows.
  • Verify successful software installation and confirm that the SDS is operational before the vehicle returns to service.
  • Support troubleshooting of software-related issues affecting autonomous vehicle behavior, system communication, or operational readiness.
  • Maintain accurate records of software versions, configurations, updates, and validation results.

    SDS Specialist - Autonomous Vehicle Diagnostics & Calibration

    About the Role

    We are looking for a Self-Driving Systems Specialist (SDS Specialist) to support the diagnostics, calibration, configuration, and technical readiness of self-driving systems used in autonomous vehicles and robotaxi fleets across Europe.

    The SDS Specialist focuses on the technology layer of autonomous mobility: sensors, compute systems, software configurations, autonomous driving hardware, system diagnostics, calibration procedures, and technical validation. This role ensures that the self-driving system installed in each autonomous vehicle is functioning correctly, accurately calibrated, and ready to support safe testing, commercial deployment, and autonomous ride-hailing operations.

    You will work closely with Senior Technicians, AV Operations Leads, Safety Operators, Depot Specialists, engineering teams, and fleet operations teams to identify technical issues, execute structured troubleshooting procedures, and support reliable operation of autonomous vehicle platforms.
